scope: Warrior 전투도끼 낙하 연결된 단일 도끼 급강하와 접촉 폭발 2차 교정

sourcePolicy.rejectedAttemptDefect: F10-F12에서 도끼머리와 하단 손잡이 조각이 분리되어 두 무기 부품처럼 보이고 셀 상하단에 중복 잔상이 생겼다.
sourcePolicy.correctionGoal: 도끼머리와 손잡이를 모든 프레임에서 하나로 연결된 강체로 유지하고, 하단 중복 손잡이와 셀 경계 잔상을 제거한다. 도끼 급강하와 F15 물리 폭발은 유지한다.
sourcePolicy.preservedTimingBoundary: 첫 접촉 F13, 최대 폭발 F15, 폭발 유지 종료 F16, 웹 피해 875ms를 유지한다.

commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D combat VFX overlay sprite sheet for AlarmQuest. Create exactly 16 chronological frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row, row-major sprite sheet. Every cell is one independent wide 361:160 combat viewport; final sheet 1444:640; Detailed hand-painted high-resolution 2D rendering; transparent RGBA; clean antialiased alpha; image-rendering auto; no pixel art. Motion grammar: CONNECTED_AXE_SNAP_SLAM_EXPLOSION. Keep the camera, crop, perspective, weapon construction, blade angle, contact point, and explosion origin mathematically fixed. The only weapon is ONE connected rigid battle axe assembly: one broad single-bladed bearded dark-gunmetal axe head firmly mounted through its visible eye onto one thick dark wooden or wrapped shaft. The shaft must physically touch and pass through the axe-head eye in every visible frame. There is never a second shaft, detached handle segment, duplicated weapon part, floating axe head, or disconnected diagonal rod. The upper end of the single shaft may be cropped only by the TOP or UPPER-RIGHT edge; no weapon part may enter from or be cropped by the bottom edge. The axe head has a reinforced square poll, one chipped curved cutting edge, and an asymmetric readable silhouette that cannot be mistaken for a comet, hammer, sword, or abstract energy blob. Fix one downward-left attack line at 18 degrees from vertical and one immutable blade-bite point P=(51%,78%). F01 is almost transparent. F02-F06 show only faint compressed-air glints in the upper-right 25% of the cell; no visible weapon part anywhere else and the bottom 25% remains fully transparent. F07-F09 show a restrained partial silhouette of the same connected axe assembly only at the upper-right crop, still above the main combat area; the head and shaft remain touching and there are no bottom fragments. The actual visible fall occurs only in three accelerating frames. F10: axe-head center=(64%,16%); its eye is connected to one shaft extending upward-right and cropped at the top edge. F11: head center=(58%,42%); the same connected shaft continues from the eye to the upper-right edge. F12: head center=(53%,67%); the same connected shaft still runs continuously upward from the eye and the cutting edge stops just above P. At F10-F12 preserve identical head profile, identical head-to-shaft connection, identical scale, and identical 18-degree angle; translate the entire rigid assembly as one unit with no rotation, separation, redraw wobble, or extra rod. Add exactly three to five thin tapered translucent blue-gray descent streaks behind the one connected weapon in F10-F12, parallel to its path, sharing one upper-right vanishing origin, never touching the bottom edge and never becoming a background panel. F13 is first contact: the connected axe blade bites P and stays attached to the same shaft, with one compact ivory-orange flash and short V-shaped pressure notch. F14 is compression: the one connected axe stops dead and remains embedded at the same angle while a low asymmetric pressure wedge, two short cracks, and a few chunky fragments move outward from P. F15 is the unique maximum: one physical ground-rooted contact explosion erupts from P around the still-visible connected axe, with a hot ivory-white core, restrained amber-ochre flame pressure, one low wide broken steel fan, six to ten chunky fragments, and two short upward air tears. The blast is wider than tall, asymmetric, and punctured by transparent corridors; it must not reach all four edges or become a circular magic effect. Keep the axe head and its connection to the shaft visibly readable through and above the explosion. F16 holds the same connected embedded axe and same explosion at 75-85% energy with slightly opened fragments; no fade, rebound, recovery, disassembly, or second blast. Playback ends on the impact at 1,000ms. Keep the top and bottom four pixels of every cell transparent except where the single connected shaft is intentionally cropped at the top in F10-F16; the bottom four pixels must always be fully transparent. Treat every cell as independently clipped with no adjacent-cell residue. Palette: dark gunmetal, cold blue-gray wind, ivory-white impact core, restrained amber and burnt ochre. Render weapon and attached VFX only: no character, arms, hands, enemy, scenery, illustrated ground plane, UI, text, grid, border, gutter, padding, or opaque background.

skills.generationPrompt: Regenerate '전투도끼 낙하' as one unmistakable connected battle axe that snaps down in three frames and explodes once on impact. Correct the rejected attempt's exact defect: never place a second handle or detached shaft below the axe head, and never let any weapon fragment touch the bottom edge. In every visible frame, show one broad bearded gunmetal axe head mounted continuously onto one thick shaft through the head eye. The upper shaft always runs from that eye toward the upper-right crop; the entire weapon translates as one rigid object. Keep F02-F06 limited to faint top-right air pressure and F07-F09 limited to a partial connected weapon at the top-right. Use the precise F10, F11, and F12 head centers declared in the common prompt for one accelerating downward snap. The axe head design, size, angle, and shaft connection must be identical across F10-F16. F13 delivers the hard 'PAK' blade bite at P; F14 compresses without rebound; F15 produces one low-wide asymmetric white-hot and amber physical explosion with chunky steel and ochre fragments while the embedded axe remains clearly readable; F16 holds the same blast at 75-85% energy and ends there. Lock the contact core and blade bite inside x=49%-53%, y=75%-81%. Preserve transparent gaps between the explosion wedges, do not draw a scene background, and do not create a neat circular or magical blast.
